Diesel Generator (DG) sets play a crucial role in providing backup power for industries, commercial buildings, hospitals, and infrastructure projects. However, DG sets also produce harmful emissions such as particulate matter, carbon monoxide, and nitrogen oxides that contribute to air pollution.

To control these emissions and meet environmental regulations, many organizations are adopting advanced technologies like Filter-less Retrofit Emission Control Devices (RECDs). Companies such as Novorbis Itus are leading the development of innovative emission control solutions designed specifically for diesel generator systems.

In this article, we explore the major benefits of using a filter-less RECD for DG sets and why industries are increasingly adopting this technology.

Understanding Filter-less RECD for DG Sets

A Filter-less Retrofit Emission Control Device is an advanced emission reduction system installed in the exhaust line of diesel generators. Unlike traditional emission control systems that rely on filters to capture soot and particulate matter, filter-less RECD technology uses catalytic reactions and advanced oxidation processes to reduce harmful emissions.

This technology allows industries to control pollution effectively without dealing with filter clogging or frequent maintenance.

Solutions developed by Novorbis Itus are designed to improve emission control while ensuring smooth operation of DG sets.

Key Benefits of Using a Filter-less RECD for DG Sets

1. Significant Reduction in Harmful Emissions

One of the primary benefits of a filter-less emission control device is its ability to significantly reduce pollutants released by diesel generators. These devices help control:

  • Particulate Matter (PM)
  • Carbon Monoxide (CO)
  • Hydrocarbons (HC)
  • Nitrogen Oxides (NOx)

By reducing these pollutants, organizations contribute to cleaner air and a healthier environment.

2. No Filter Blockage Issues

Traditional emission control systems rely on filters that trap soot and particulate matter. Over time, these filters can become clogged, which can affect system performance.

Filter-less RECD technology eliminates this problem because it does not rely on physical filtration. This ensures smooth exhaust flow and consistent performance.

3. Lower Maintenance Requirements

Maintenance is a major concern for businesses using diesel generator systems. Filter-based emission systems often require periodic cleaning or replacement of filters.

With filter-less technology, maintenance requirements are significantly reduced. This results in:

  • Lower maintenance costs
  • Reduced downtime
  • Improved operational efficiency

Solutions provided by Novorbis Itus are designed to deliver long-term reliability with minimal maintenance.

4. Easy Installation on Existing DG Sets

One of the biggest advantages of a filter-less RECD is that it can be retrofitted into existing DG sets. This means businesses do not need to replace their generators to meet emission standards.

The device can be installed directly in the exhaust system, making the upgrade simple and cost-effective.

5. Compliance with Environmental Regulations

Governments and environmental authorities are enforcing stricter emission standards to reduce air pollution. In India, the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) has introduced emission norms for DG sets.

Installing a filter-less emission control device helps organizations comply with these regulations and avoid penalties.

Companies like Novorbis Itus design solutions that help businesses meet these regulatory requirements.

6. Improved Engine Efficiency

Some emission control systems can create back pressure in the exhaust system, which may affect engine performance.

Filter-less RECD devices allow smoother exhaust gas flow, ensuring that the generator operates efficiently without affecting engine performance.

7. Long-Term Cost Savings

While emission control systems are an investment, filter-less technology offers long-term financial benefits.

Businesses can save money through:

  • Reduced maintenance costs
  • No filter replacement expenses
  • Improved operational efficiency

This makes filter-less RECD systems a cost-effective solution for emission control.

Industries That Benefit from Filter-less RECD for DG Sets

Filter-less emission control devices are widely used in sectors that rely on diesel generators for backup or continuous power supply.

These include:

  • Manufacturing industries
  • Hospitals and healthcare facilities
  • Commercial buildings and malls
  • Data centers
  • Construction sites
  • Infrastructure projects
  • Hotels and hospitality industry

By installing emission control technology, these industries can operate responsibly while meeting environmental standards.

With a strong focus on sustainability and innovation, Novorbis Itus helps industries transition toward cleaner energy practices.

Conclusion

Diesel generators are essential for uninterrupted power supply, but they also contribute to air pollution. Installing a Filter-less Retrofit Emission Control Device is an effective way to reduce emissions while maintaining operational efficiency.

With benefits such as lower maintenance, easy installation, regulatory compliance, and improved environmental performance, filter-less RECD technology is becoming the preferred emission control solution for DG sets.

By adopting advanced solutions from Novorbis Itus, industries can ensure cleaner operations while supporting environmental sustainability.
